_comment: The opt-in PostToolUse edit hook (scripts/okf-edit-hook.py). OKF_EDIT_HOOK_TIMEOUT overrides timeout_seconds.
_timeout_reason: The scoped check measured 0.33 s on a 100-note bundle (macOS, 2026-10-18); 4 s leaves room for a large bundle's link scan and stays under the 5 s platform timeout set in hooks/hooks.json, so the hook's own box fires first and exits silently.
_max_reason: OKF_EDIT_HOOK_TIMEOUT cannot raise the box past this: hooks/hooks.json cancels the hook at 5 s, and a cancelled hook leaves okf-check running in its own session, so the hook's own box must fire first.
_line_reason: The one stderr line Claude reads quotes note values back; control characters are replaced and the line is cut here so a hostile note cannot flood or steer it.
